page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.large is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is equipped with 2 dedicated vCPUs running on an Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor with x86_64 architecture, clocked at 3.2 GHz. The instance delivers 8.0 GB of system memory, matching the standard 1:4 core-to-memory proportion with 4.0 GB allocated per virtual core.

The hardware configuration includes no integrated local storage, requiring cloud block storage volumes for persistent data and operating system installations. The instance does not feature graphical processing units or hardware accelerators. Network connectivity is configured with a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, and the platform assigns zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses by default.

Because the ecs.g9i.large allocates dedicated CPU cores rather than shared or burstable capacity, it avoids performance throttling under continuous utilization. The small resource envelope prevents unneeded capacity overhead for smaller workloads, maintaining qualitative cost efficiency. The instance is suited for lightweight enterprise workloads, microservice hosting, small databases, application testing, and general-purpose web serving.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9i.large is a general-purpose cloud instance configured with 2 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, delivering a balanced 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio with 4.0 GB per core. Powered by an x86_64 Intel Xeon 6982P-C processor operating at 3.2 GHz under the KVM hypervisor, this instance provides steady, dedicated CPU performance. The specification includes no integrated local storage and no GPU accelerators, relying on external network-attached block storage for system and application data. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 2 Gbps, while zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default. Given its dedicated core allocation and compact hardware footprint, the ecs.g9i.large delivers predictable execution and cost-efficient utilization for entry-level deployments. It is suited for moderate enterprise services, web application serving, API microservices, staging environments, and small relational or in-memory databases.
